$doc: Which materials get which parts. A family pairs material selectors with part ids, so metals get metal parts and fluids get bottles, never the cross product.
Selectors: 'iron' (one material), '@metal' (a group from materials.json), '*' (all). 'exclude' takes 'material:part' rules, e.g. '@gem:wire'.
family.defaults is merged into every item the family produces, before the part's own spec.
